{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-TEST-20260907-2249-A7KQ9M",
  "department": "SCENE",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "scene_decisions": {
    "upstream_dependency": "SCENE handoff is conditional because CHARACTER and CLOTHING are REPAIR pending canonical Inaria identity and hairstyle confirmation.",
    "location": "Use readable, believable environments that support the character, wardrobe, and pose without becoming identity signals. Candidate contexts include a quiet residential interior, a temperate urban walkway, and an uncluttered natural setting.",
    "environment": "Maintain coherent scale, perspective, horizon placement, object spacing, and background depth. Keep hands, feet, face, joints, and silhouette areas clear of distracting objects.",
    "season": "Season may vary intentionally after wardrobe compatibility and canonical identity are confirmed. Do not change season, weather, lighting, and location simultaneously for every sample.",
    "weather": "Use controlled variation such as clear, overcast, or light seasonal conditions when contextually appropriate. Avoid extreme weather that obscures facial identity, clothing construction, or anatomy.",
    "time": "Prefer daylight, bright overcast, or softly controlled early-evening conditions for core identity evaluation. Time-of-day variation must not reduce facial readability.",
    "lighting": "Use even, directional lighting with sufficient facial exposure, stable skin-tone representation, and readable clothing materials. Avoid harsh shadows, colored casts, backlighting, glare, or atmospheric effects that interfere with identity QA.",
    "atmosphere": "Use restrained atmospheric depth and environmental storytelling. Fog, rain, dust, foliage, crowds, and decorative effects must remain subordinate to the character.",
    "background_readability": "Keep backgrounds simple to moderate in complexity, with separation from the character through contrast, depth, and uncluttered negative space. Avoid high-frequency patterns behind the face, hands, feet, and joints.",
    "composition_and_scale": "Use believable camera-to-subject distance, grounded feet where visible, consistent perspective, and natural object placement. Do not allow scene framing or props to redefine body proportions.",
    "diversity_strategy": "Create intentional scene diversity through controlled rotation of location, season, weather, time, lighting, and environmental meaning while preserving identity readability. Track combinations to prevent repetitive backgrounds without changing all variables at once.",
    "handoff_readiness": "SCENE constraints can be passed to POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, and DIRECTOR only after CHARACTER and CLOTHING reach PASS or an explicitly approved repair-compatible state.",
    "production_scope": "This is an integration test only; no production assets are authorized or created."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Canonical Inaria identity, age presentation, facial structure, skin tone, body proportions, and identity-bearing hairstyle must remain unchanged.",
    "Scene design must support character, clothing, and pose and must never redefine identity.",
    "Lighting must permit reliable identity evaluation for core identity samples.",
    "Backgrounds must remain subordinate, readable, and free of accidental identity signals.",
    "Avoid clutter, occlusion, tangencies, and high-contrast objects near the face, hands, feet, joints, and anatomy-critical regions.",
    "Perspective, scale, grounding, and object placement must remain believable and coherent.",
    "No scene choice may cause malformed anatomy, unstable proportions, duplicate or missing limbs, fused fingers, distorted feet, or garment-body intersections to be accepted.",
    "Scene variation must be intentional and must not compromise generation stability or recognizability.",
    "JSON-only department output is required.",
    "No production assets may be created during this test run.",
    "Final scene approval is blocked while upstream CHARACTER and CLOTHING handoffs remain REPAIR."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Rotate among uncluttered interior, urban, and natural locations while preserving consistent subject readability.",
    "Vary season and weather in controlled combinations appropriate to the approved wardrobe.",
    "Vary daylight, overcast, and restrained early-evening lighting while preserving facial and clothing detail.",
    "Use modest changes in background depth, color temperature, and environmental storytelling without overpowering the character.",
    "Vary camera-facing background geometry and negative-space placement while preserving believable scale and perspective.",
    "Use occasional simple props only when they support the scene narrative and remain clear of anatomy-critical regions.",
    "Track location, season, weather, time, lighting, palette, and prop combinations to satisfy diversity gates without uncontrolled variable changes."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "SCENE cannot receive PASS because the approved CHARACTER and CLOTHING handoffs are both REPAIR.",
    "The canonical Inaria identity and hairstyle reference is unavailable in the current context, preventing confirmation that scene lighting, palette, scale, and environmental contrast preserve identity correctly.",
    "Downstream POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, DIRECTOR, failover routing, anatomy and generation-stability validation, diversity gates, and final QA traceability remain blocked pending upstream repair.",
    "Required repair: resolve the canonical Inaria reference through GitHub/shared memory or attach the approved identity specification, rerun CHARACTER and CLOTHING validation, then rerun SCENE and downstream integration checks.",
    "No production assets were created."
  ]
}
